_README: Khmer (km) translation workbook — "Projectile Sampling Distributions" PhET simulation.
SCOPE: only text that this sim actually puts on screen (verified by inspecting the running
sim) plus the sim's own strings. Strings belonging to other PhET sims are excluded.
HOW TO USE:
1. Read the "en" (English) value.
2. Type the Khmer translation into the "km" field.
3. Leaving "km" empty keeps that string in English.
4. Send the file back and the translations get applied.
IMPORTANT — placeholders:
Keep every {{...}} and {0} token exactly as-is. Examples:
"Launcher {{number}}"           ->  "គ្រាប់បាញ់ {{number}}"
"Lead Design: {0}"              ->  "អ្នករចនាដឹកនាំ៖ {0}"
A {{...}} or {0} is replaced at runtime with a live value; dropping it breaks the sim text.
NOTES:
- "group":
sim-content       = written specifically for this sim (screens, controls, its own Preferences).
framework-visible = shared PhET UI confirmed to appear on screen (menus, a11y labels, key names).
framework-dialogs = PhET menu / About / Credits / License / Updates text.
- "kmExists": true means PhET already has Khmer for that key and the "km" field is prefilled.
- Do NOT rename any "key".
- This file is the review copy. On return it is split into per-repo files:
babel/<repo>/<repo>-strings_km.json
which is the layout PhET itself uses for translations.
